title: Write the box-projection helper
author: claude
summary: A helper that corrects reflections, without removing the configurator's own patches.
what: We wrote a helper that adds the box-projection correction to materials, on top of any patch they already have, and a shared switch to turn it on and off.
why: The configurator already patches its materials, and those patches must keep working.
how: The helper chains onto any existing patch. The on/off switch is the box projection slider.

tech.name: Box projection
tech.plain: A trick that makes reflections line up with the real walls instead of looking infinitely far away.

tech.name: three.js
tech.plain: Draws 3D scenes in the web browser.

meta.mechanism: chains onto any existing onBeforeCompile; a shared uniform turns it on and off
